integration_decision.name: EXECUTION_PROVENANCE_GATE_NO_MORE_SOURCE_ONLY_TEST_REVISIONS
integration_decision.basis: Refreshed exact public source blobs and pinned two-writer specification: runner publishes latest/audit/anata JSON in three separate atomic writes; the proposed P0 overlay is absent from public HEAD and its conditional B wait does not prove B overtook A. GitHub connector provides exact source/tree read-back, but not a local runnable exact-SHA checkout. No new test design would resolve missing execution evidence.
acceptance: On authorized disposable exact-SHA checkout, run unchanged python -m pytest -q part2/capital_flow/tests with captured stdout/stderr, -rs, exit code.
Materialize pinned P0 overlay only in disposable test workspace; hash it and require witnessed B-over-A ordering and both writer exit codes; without witness classify INCONCLUSIVE.
Treat unchanged-code RED vector [1800000060000,1800000000000,1800000000000] as unexecuted hypothesis, not defect proof. Require post-Gemini targeted and full GREEN on same new SHA.
Keep P1 process admission and concurrent reader snapshot atomicity as separate unverified contracts.
